title.narrative: Improving timely access, availability and utilization of multi­sectoral services to vulnerable and conflict-affected girls and women in Yobe State

description.narrative: ltpgt1. This proposal submission is for Thematic Envelope 1- Underfunded Sector Area-Based Protection Responselt/pgtltpgt ltbrgt2. Explain clearly how this project will contribute to the protection of girls and vulnerable women.lt/pgtltpgt lt/pgtltpgtThis project seeks to enhance the protection of the Girl Child, vulnerable women and people with disabilities by implementing GBV and Education sectoral activities that will enhance the safety and well-being of girls and women. Thus, interventions will mainstream efforts within the Education and Protection GBV Sectors through comprehensive and intersectoral approaches that enhance school, community and institutional resilience in 3 LGAs (Fune, Geidam and Gujba) of Yobe State. lt/pgtltpgt ltbrgtFocused activities will involve establishing safe spaces and supporting networks for GBV survivors/persons at risk in Schools and Communities, capacity building for GBV-related healthcare workers on GBV Prevention and Services provision (CMR, GBV Case Management, MHPSS), capacity building SBMC/Parents/Teachers, implementing community-based/school awareness campaigns on SRGBV/PSEA/GBV Prevention and referral pathway, enhancing access to second chance education and sanitation facilities, including empowering adolescents and young women with skills that enhance their resilience, self-esteem, livelihood and overall agency. Tltspangthe project will actively involve government officials, community stakeholders and various actors within the humanitarian project value chain, to enhance educational outcomes and prevent/mitigate gender-based violence in the 3 LGAslt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspangtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtThe project will fortify community safety mechanisms, promote equitable community norms, and amplify the voices of girls and vulnerable women, thus facilitating their active participation in family and community affairs. lt/pgtltpgt3. What specific innovation this project is bringing?ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltigtltbrgtlt/igtlt/pgtltpgtltigtThe project innovation is to empower and build the resilience of girls and vulnerable women by incorporating personal safety and resilience skills into basic education and GBV prevention and response services. The project seeks to foster an inclusive environment for girls and vulnerable women through personalized education, empowerment, and community involvement thus promoting gender equality norms and expanding GBV prevention and response serviceslt/igtlt/pgtltpgtltigtltbrgtlt/igtAt the end of the project, we seek to reach 15,000 Girls and Vulnerable Women with comprehensive GBV prevention and response services and 2800 Girls with enhanced access to skills-based quality education. The implementation of planned services will be guided by Guidance notes on mainstreaming protection services across the humanitarian sectors.ltbrgtlt/pgt
